start_here: Say to your AI: "I read SORT-PLAN.md and it is fine: make the planned YouTube playlists from sort-plan.json, one playlist first." It runs apply_sort.py with limit_playlists 1 on your computer and tells you which playlist it made and how many videos it added.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads a plan file and writes only what it made to the applied_file you name.
instructions: 1. Make the plan with tool:plan-sorting-youtube-watch-later-into-playlists and read SORT-PLAN.md; held-back and low-confidence videos are marked there. This tool publishes, so say yes only when the plan is right.
2. Export your browser's YouTube login with tool:export-browser-login-cookies-for-yt-dlp (cookies.txt).

3. Say the start_here sentence. Your AI reads the tool's row with tools:list and runs python3 -I tools/sort-youtube-watch-later-into-playlists/do-work/apply_sort.py < request.json from the Workshop checkout, with {cookies, plan_file, applied_file, limit_playlists: 1}.

4. Read the last JSON line: {"result":{"playlists":[...]}} names each playlist and how many videos were added now; run it again without the limit to make the rest (it adds only what is missing), then run do-work/verify_sort.py with {cookies, plan_file, applied_file, accounts_dir} and read INDEX.md.

worked_examples.title: Make one planned playlist, then run again safely
worked_examples.ask: Make the first playlist of my sort plan on YouTube.
worked_examples.given: From tools/sort-youtube-watch-later-into-playlists/test/test_sort.py (test_creates_adds_only_missing_reuses_and_is_safe_to_rerun): sort-plan.json has account a with playlist Bread (description Loaves., videos w1 w2 w3) and playlist Old (video w1); the channel already has an empty playlist titled Old. The AI runs, from the Workshop checkout: echo '{"cookies":"cookies.txt","plan_file":"sort-plan.json","applied_file":"applied.json","batch":2}' | python3 -I tools/sort-youtube-watch-later-into-playlists/do-work/apply_sort.py
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"playlists": [{"slug": "a", "title": "Bread", "id": "<the new playlist id>", "created": true, "reused": false, "planned": 3, "added_now": 1}, {"slug": "a", "title": "Old", "id": "PLold", "created": false, "reused": true, "planned": 1, "added_now": 1}]}} (Bread was made with its first 2 videos, so 1 is added now). Run again, every added_now is 0 and nothing is written; no video is ever removed.
